rows.name: tabs
rows.description: The tabs — each { key, title, content, isDisabled?, icon?, tabAriaLabel?, help?, isCloseDisabled? }.

rows.name: activeKey
rows.description: Controlled active key. Omit to let TabbedView manage it.

rows.name: defaultActiveKey
rows.description: Initial active key when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first tab.

rows.name: onSelect
rows.description: Fired with the next key when a tab is selected.

rows.name: isFilled
rows.description: Stretch tabs to fill the available width.

rows.name: ariaLabel
rows.description: Accessible name for the tablist (rendered as a <nav>).

rows.name: tab.help
rows.description: Per-tab help popover — TabbedView wires the trigger ref + Popover for you.

rows.name: onAdd
rows.description: Show an add-tab (+) button; append to your tab array in the handler.

rows.name: addAriaLabel
rows.description: Accessible name for the add button.

rows.name: onClose
rows.description: Make tabs closable; remove the key from your array. TabbedView re-focuses a neighbour if the active tab closed.
